definitions.scope: all request_slo stage transitions when io.log_stage_transitions is enabled
definitions.category: the open category term before ':' in run_meta.stage_vocab.names; every category, including done, is preserved at cluster and worker levels
definitions.worker_category: time-weighted population in one category at the event's request-owner (pool, worker) location
definitions.done: terminal category; completed requests remain resident here so the stacked cluster populations conserve all stage-tracked requests
definitions.pending: all pending:* stages, grouped by the event's numeric request-owner pool and worker location
definitions.request_owner_pools: only pools represented by stage events are published; the full run_meta worker roster is retained inside each represented pool
definitions.pool_total_pending: sum of worker pending queue depths in the pool
definitions.pool_average_pending: pool total pending divided by the run_meta worker roster size
definitions.bin: one of 200 equal-width simulated-time bins; plotted values are exact time-weighted means within each bin
